annotations.title: Re-file a bank line (preview, then confirm)

description: Re-file a bank line that was already filed wrongly: reverses everything it posted (one reversal journal on the line's date, payments taken back off invoices/bills) and files it again to the new target. Same target arguments as accounting_file_bank_line. TWO STEPS: first call = preview of the reversal and new journal + confirm_token; second call with confirm_token does it. Changes the user's real books — only after they have seen the preview and agreed. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

confirm_token.description: Second step only: the token from the preview

name: accounting_refile_bank_line
